scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,metro --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently --names server,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/web"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently --names server,metro,ios --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,blue --delay 5000 "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app" "npm run ios --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager"
scripts.dev:android: tsx scripts/setupAndroidDevice.ts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,metro,android --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,green --delay 5000 "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app" "npm run android --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names server,metro,ios,android --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,blue,green --delay 5000 "npm run dev --workspace=packages/server" "npm run start --workspace=packages/app" "npm run ios --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager" "npm run android --workspace=packages/app -- --no-packager"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json packages/types packages/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/icons && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/app
scripts.depcheck: depcheck && find packages -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 depcheck
scripts.ci: concurrently --group --names validate,typecheck,lint,lint-rules,workflows,audit,depcheck,knip,jscpd,test --prefix-colors white,blue,yellow,cyan,white,magenta,red,gray,gray,green "npm run validate:node-version" "npm run typecheck" "npm run lint" "npm run lint:unused-rules" "npm run workflows:lint" "npm run audit" "npm run depcheck" "npm run knip" "npm run jscpd" "npm run test:coverage"
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 turbo test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:scripts && TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 turbo test:coverage
